# Bank OZK Deep Dive Analysis

Report 136 | Published 2024-05-12 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-5-12/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/136.json)

Bank OZK amid liquidity and crypto transitions.

OZK continued earning substantial profits but later incurred material property losses. Those losses challenge a broad impression of immunity; missing loan-vintage details prevent a clean refutation of the new-underwriting argument. The equity horizon remains open. The 2025 Fed balance-sheet turn was correctly anticipated.

**Coverage:** Full text read, including distributional macro, Japan, on-chain data, identity/stablecoins and the bank credit deep dive.

### 136-C02

**QT taper precedes 2025 expansion.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | 2025 |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | fed-balance-sheet-2025-pivot |

QT was already announced to slow; the genuinely forward component, new purchases during 2025, occurred in December. Avoid counting the known taper as a forecast.

**Direction:** Supported for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** 2025

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Changes to balance sheet reduction](https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_240501) | Federal Reserve Bank of New York | 2024-05-01 | Verified in the audit

Effective June 1, Treasury runoff cap fell from $60 billion to $25 billion monthly; agency cap remained $35 billion.

- [Reserve management purchases](https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_251210a) | Federal Reserve Bank of New York | 2025-12-10 | Verified in the audit

The Desk announced $40 billion of initial bill purchases starting December 12, to maintain ample reserves. This is not itself evidence of deficit monetization as the causal motive.

### 136-C18

**Dencun reduces burn and raises issuance.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | ethereum-dencun-monetary-effects |
| Source blocks | 138 |
| Thesis family | ethereum-dencun-monetary-effects |

Independent on-chain analysis confirms reduced fee burn after Dencun and a shift back to net inflation. The precise claim concerns net supply growth; Dencun did not simply raise the gross validator reward schedule.

**Direction:** Supported for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Ethereum issuance and burn analysis](https://www.cmegroup.com/articles/files/2025/glassnode-ether-report.pdf) | CME Group / Glassnode | Verified in the audit

2025 report with data through May: net post-Merge supply change bottomed at about -427,000 ETH in March 2024; lower fee pressure after Dencun plus lighter demand reduced burn, leaving cumulative net supply about +294,000 ETH. Lower burn raises net issuance, not necessarily the gross validator issuance schedule.

- [Dencun upgrade specification](https://blog.ethereum.org/2024/02/27/dencun-mainnet-announcement) | Ethereum Foundation | 2024-02-27 | Verified in the audit

Introduced temporary blobs through EIP-4844 to reduce rollup transaction fees; scheduled March 13, 2024.
